title: Understanding Linear Independence
text: To determine if a set of columns is linearly independent, consider if any column can be expressed as a linear combination of the others. If it can, the columns are not linearly independent.

title: Converting Units
text: Remember that height in inches is calculated as height in centimeters divided by $$2.54$$, and weight in pounds is weight in kilograms multiplied by $$2.2$$. Check if these conversions affect linear independence.

title: Checking Linear Independence
text: Can height (in) be expressed as a linear combination of height (cm)?

title: Impact of BMI
text: Does the BMI column depend on the height and weight columns?

title: Span of Columns
text: The span of a set of vectors is the set of all possible linear combinations of those vectors. Consider if adding or removing columns changes the span.
